3. Reference Calibration: No human-scored reference images were provided, so this check was not applicable.

I independently verified the absence of the cookie by visually inspecting the entire scene and confirming no baked goods or disc-shaped objects exist. The texture anomaly on the turtle shell (severity 1) and slight leg fusion on cows (severity 2) were noted but did not disproportionately lower the overall authenticity score, as the primary failures are semantic (missing object, wrong count).
6. Atom Score Review: Each atom score is justified. Turtle presence/color/count are visually confirmed. Cookie absence is definitive. Cow count (4 vs expected 5) and glass material are visually verified. Spatial relationship fails due to missing cookie.
7. Upward Override Justification: No upward overrides were made. All positive verdicts (turtle present, purple, glass cows) are directly supported by visual evidence without relying solely on the Router.

Final scores remain unchanged from the initial assessment as they accurately reflect the image's fidelity to the prompt and visual reality.
